user_requested_change.summary: Do not treat a missed single numeric gate as proof that the route is meaningless when there is clear positive signal.
user_requested_change.avoid_wording: Do not emphasize the actor of sample review; use neutral decision wording.

decision_layers.technical_validity: Runs, hashes, model/data identity, row counts, and prohibited-data controls must be valid.
decision_layers.responsibility_usability: A component can continue when core responsibilities do not show unacceptable practical regression and at least one main or mechanism metric gives interpretable positive signal.
decision_layers.strong_claim: Strong statistical wording requires the frozen pre-registered statistical rule.
decision_layers.controlled_continuation: Positive, localized, reproducible signal without leakage or tripwire can proceed with restricted claims.
